case_title: Sikandar Singh & Ors. v. State of Bihar
aggravating_circumstances: Common object of unlawful assembly, use of lethal weapons
neutral_facts: The accused were part of an unlawful assembly with a common object to eliminate the deceased and his brother. The deceased was cleaning a plot of land that was the subject of a pending title dispute. The accused, armed with guns and other lethal weapons, confronted the deceased and his brother. One of the accused fired at the deceased, resulting in his death, and also fired at the deceased's brother, causing injuries. Villagers witnessed the incident and reported it to the police. The prosecution presented medical evidence showing the deceased sustained fatal injuries from gunshot wounds, while the accused's brother sustained non-fatal injuries. The trial court convicted the accused for murder and attempted murder, and the High Court upheld the conviction.
